# TexContractor

> TexContractor (texcontractor.com) is a free directory of local, individual home-service pros in Texas and across the U.S. Customers find a pro by service and city and text or call them directly. There are no lead fees, no bidding and no middleman. Customers can also post a free job request so local pros can text them offers. English and Spanish.

Key facts:
- Free for customers and for pros. Pros never pay per lead.
- Customers contact the pro directly (text, call or chat on TexContractor).
- Listings are for individual, self-employed technicians (not big companies).
- Each pro has a profile with their service, city, work photos, hours, languages and badges such as Insured, Licensed or Clear background check. Badges are entered by the pro.
- Pages exist for every service in every Texas city, plus other U.S. states.

## How to find a pro
- [Find a pro by service and ZIP](https://texcontractor.com/contractor.html): choose a service, enter a ZIP code, text the pro directly.
- [Browse by city](https://texcontractor.com/local/): every service in every city. URL pattern: https://texcontractor.com/local/tx/<city>/<service>.html (example: [Plumbers in Dallas, TX](https://texcontractor.com/local/tx/dallas/plumbing-pipe-repair.html)).
- [Post a free job request](https://texcontractor.com/requests.html): local pros see it and text you.
- [En español](https://texcontractor.com/es/local/)
